mastery_task.scenario_en: A fictional learner needs a six-sentence profile for a class page.
mastery_task.scenario_ar: متعلم خيالي يحتاج نبذة من ست جمل لصفحة الدورة.
mastery_task.prompt_en: Write the profile from a fresh fact card and correct its one false detail.
mastery_task.support: Fact labels only; no complete sentence frames or model profile.
mastery_task.freshness: The person, relationships, facts, quantities, false detail, and order are new.

replacement_mastery_task.scenario_en: A fictional volunteer needs a short profile for a community board.
replacement_mastery_task.scenario_ar: متطوع خيالي يحتاج نبذة قصيرة للوحة مجتمعية.
replacement_mastery_task.prompt_en: Write an equivalent six-sentence profile and correct the changed false detail.
replacement_mastery_task.support: Fact labels only; no complete sentence frames or model profile.
replacement_mastery_task.freshness: A new person, family structure, pet, and correction preserve the construct.

rubric.level_2: All fact-card relationships and the false detail are understood.
The profile communicates every required fact in five to seven sentences.
New people, quantities, relations, and facts are expressed without copying the model.
Subject reference, key verb agreement, quantity, connector meaning, and negative correction remain clear.

decision.demonstrated: Level 2 or above on every required dimension.
decision.needs_review: Any required dimension below level 2; use targeted practice and a new task.
decision.completion_rule: Opening sections or finishing exercises never grants mastery.

teach_back_variant.prompt_ar: اشرح ليه نقول I have لكن she has، واذكر الفرق بين and وbut بمثال قصير.

omit_variant.content: Proceed directly to the matched close and review card.

delayed_review.task: Write four changed facts with have/has and quantity.
Correct a false profile fact and connect two ideas.
Write a fresh six-sentence fictional profile.
